title: AI Engineering Orchestra Agent Execution Authorization Grant
description: Structural schema for one positive, Run-bound Agent Execution Authorization Grant defined by core/agent-execution-authorization-grant-specification.md.

grant_id.description: Exact opaque issuer-allocated Grant identity within one authorization-domain and issuer namespace.

run.description: Exact complete Agent Execution Run bound to this Grant.

authorization_domain_id.description: Exact opaque authorization-consumer and future shared-consumption-ledger domain identity.

issuer_kind.description: Closed declared issuer category; structural validity does not authenticate the issuer.

issuer_id.description: Exact opaque issuer identity asserted by the external authority producer.

provenance_reference.description: Exact opaque audit-only provenance reference; not identity or authentication proof.

issued_at.description: Canonical UTC issuance timestamp; currentness is not evaluated.

expires_at.description: Canonical UTC expiry timestamp; currentness is not evaluated.
